intents.title: A fresh single-root client maps its code
intents.statement: A blueprint with exactly one node implicitly owns all code, so the first turn maps and commits. Once a second node exists mapping is explicit; a root **/* catch-all has the lowest priority and never beats a specific node.

intents.title: Hash code files as raw working-tree bytes
intents.statement: tree_hashes uses the raw file bytes for code as well as .afwe sources, matching post_hashes, snapshots and rewind classification. The analyzer's normalized parse hash is not used for the expected tree.

intents.title: Keep git status clean after an isolated commit
intents.statement: After commit_isolated updates the branch, the main index is reset to the new commit for exactly the expanded paths the turn committed, preserving unrelated staged work. A fresh client no longer wakes with .afwe staged as deleted plus untracked.

intents.title: Keep the local audit out of the client repo
intents.statement: The generated client ignores .afwe/log and turns no longer stage it, so the append-only engine ledger remains the committed history and a normal turn leaves git status clean.

intents.title: Report the current format and onboarding truth
intents.statement: The generated README reports FORMAT_VERSION (afwe/3); SPEC documents afwe/3 and the implicit-root rule; TUTORIAL explains init vs onboard and the real --legacy bootstrap behaviour.

intents.title: Cache the real manifest and install from ReBorn
intents.statement: The generated CI gate hashes .afwe/afwe.yaml (not the nonexistent manifest.yaml) and installs afwe-cli from the ReBorn branch.

intents.title: Test the generated client and the mapping rules
intents.statement: Unit tests assert the generated scaffold carries the new docs, format, backups/log ignore and one root node; mapping tests cover implicit single-root, catch-all priority and specific children; the rewind/P3 integration test uses the real queue.get op.
